name: Liu I-chih
bio: Liu I-chih (劉一止; Liu Yizhi; 1078–1160) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 喜迁莺 (Xi qian ying)
poems.author: Liu I-chih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
晓光催角。
听宿鸟未惊，邻鸡先觉。
迤逦烟村，马嘶人起，残月尚穿林薄。
泪痕带霜微凝，酒力冲寒犹弱。
叹倦客、悄不禁，重染风尘京洛。
追念，人别後，心事万重，难觅孤鸿托。
翠幌娇深，曲屏香暖，争念岁寒飘泊。
怨月恨花烦恼，不是不曾经著。
这情味，望一成消减，新来还恶。
